All 12 cache store tests pass, including the new `store_uses_atomic_write` test.

The fix: `CacheStore::store()` and `save_metadata()` were using plain `fs::write()`, which is not atomic — a concurrent reader could see a partially-written file. This matches the bug description of cache corruption during concurrent tool installations.

The fix applies the same write-to-temp-then-rename pattern already used by `StateStore` (`src/state/store.rs:166`), `ProjectIndex` (`src/state/index.rs:74`), and `Preferences` (`src/state/preferences.rs:72`). The `fs::rename` call is atomic on POSIX filesystems, so concurrent readers will either see the old complete file or the new complete file, never a partial write.
